purpose: Demonstrate one complete governed multi-source execution; this protocol is not a performance benchmark.

query_semantics.spatial_metric: Haversine over explicitly bound EPSG:4326 point pairs

controlled_governance_augmentation.statement: The sensitivity label and policy are deterministic experimental governance attributes; they are not claimed to originate in the public NYSDEC dataset.

smoke_gates: all four raw downloads match their SHA-256 audits
all four prepared Parquet files match the processed manifest
policy validation rewrites exactly one hash Mask and source LineageCapture
DuckDB physical plan has no unimplemented feature
execution returns a non-empty deterministic result digest
raw API well numbers are absent from governed output
source lineage covers every contributing scan
certificate independently verifies plan, snapshots, events, result, and lineage
tampered result, snapshot, lineage, or event ordering is rejected
scientific_boundaries: This is one end-to-end case study, not an optimizer performance result.
Record-level lineage is not claimed for SpatialJoin.
The current backend implements distance_within only; intersects and within remain fail-closed.
No query radius or predicate may be changed after the smoke result merely to improve latency.
